registry: Cedar Press U.S. Tribal & Native Business Source Registry
scope: United States only. Tribal-government, TERO and tribal member/citizen lists are the primary evidence layer; state, chamber, nonprofit and regional directories are cross-reference only.

coverage.bia_list_total_note: verified 2026-08-28 against the FR 2026-01-30 notice itself (91 FR 4102, owner-supplied PDF; research/bia_list_2026-01-30/). Crosswalk rows can exceed 575 because the combined Capitan Grande and Pribilof Islands entries are represented by their member rows

matching_rules: A Tribal Primary assertion controls over every secondary source.
Tribal Secondary sources may add records or fields, but must retain their mixed or non-certification caveat.
Tribal Partnership sources represent confirmed programs or rosters that Cedar should obtain directly.
Cross-reference sources may propose matches and affiliations, but cannot create a tribal ownership assertion on their own.
Conflicts remain as parallel source assertions until resolved, rather than being silently overwritten.
